verses.text: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
words: for in thee do I put my trust.

verses.text: O my soul, thou hast said unto the Lord, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
words: O my soul, thou hast said
my goodness extendeth not to thee;

verses.text: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
words: in whom is all my delight.

verses.text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
words: places; yea, I have a goodly

verses.text: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
I have set the Lord always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
words: before me: because he is at my right hand,

verses.text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
